entities.summary: Guru das Agrawal, also known as Sant Swami Sanand, Professor G. D. Agrawal or Sant Swami Gyan Swaroop Sanand, was an Indian environmentalist, engineer, religious leader, monk, and professor. He was the Patron of Ganga Mahasabha, founded by Madan Mohan Malviya in 1905.
